page.layout: One binding cover, with no printed text blocks. Blind-stamped decorative frames fill the board. A dark ink mark sits near the centre. Two clasp straps with metal plates are on the left edge, and raised bands run down the spine on the right.
page.notes: Cover of a binding, not a printed page. Blind-tooled ornamental borders and panels, with no lettering. The dark mark in the upper centre is an ink stamp or smudge, not printed text. Brownish spots near the lower centre are stains. Two metal clasps and their leather straps are on the left edge.
